title: About Briefbox Digital
desc: Briefbox Digital is an AI automation, digital marketing, content and web development studio serving brands in the USA, UK and Europe.
body:
Briefbox Digital is a digital studio that brings AI automation, digital marketing, content and web development together under one team. We work remotely with businesses in the United States, the United Kingdom and across Europe.

Why we exist

Many businesses hire one freelancer for ads, another for the website and a third for automation, and then spend months coordinating them. We built Briefbox Digital so strategy, systems, traffic and content are planned together and measured in one place.

How we work

We start with a free call, agree a written scope and publish our packages openly on the pricing page. We set up tracking before launching campaigns, use AI to work faster and keep a person responsible for quality, and report results in plain language.

Our principles

  • Honesty: we do not promise rankings or guaranteed sales.
  • Ownership: your accounts, data and final assets belong to you.
  • Privacy: we design with GDPR, UK GDPR and CCPA principles in mind.
  • Clarity: clear scope, clear prices and regular updates.

Work with us

Ready to talk? Contact us or book a free strategy call.

title: Privacy Policy
desc: How Briefbox Digital collects, uses and protects personal data, and the rights you have under GDPR, UK GDPR and CCPA.
body:
Last updated: November 2026.

Who we are

Briefbox Digital (“we”, “us”) operates briefboxdigital.com and is the controller of personal data collected through this website. You can contact us at hello@briefboxdigital.com.

Data we collect

We collect the information you send us through our contact and booking forms, such as your name, email address, selected service and message. With your consent we also collect analytics and advertising data through cookies and similar technologies, such as pages visited, device information and approximate location.

How we use data

We use your data to respond to enquiries, schedule calls, provide services, improve our website and measure the performance of our marketing. We do not sell personal data.

Legal bases

Where GDPR or UK GDPR applies, we rely on your consent for analytics and advertising cookies, on our legitimate interests for running and securing the website, and on contract or pre-contract steps when you ask us for a service.

Service providers

We use trusted providers to run the website and handle communications, such as hosting, form handling, email, analytics and advertising platforms including Google and Meta. They process data on our instructions or under their own privacy terms.

Retention

We keep enquiry data for as long as needed to respond and maintain business records, and delete it when it is no longer required.

Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete or export your data, to object to or restrict processing, to withdraw consent and to complain to your data protection authority. California residents have rights under the CCPA, including the right to know and to delete. Email us to make a request.

International transfers

Some providers are located outside your country. Where required, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses.

Cookies

See our Cookie Policy. You can change your choice at any time using Cookie settings in the footer.

Changes

We may update this policy and will change the date above when we do.

title: Terms of Service
desc: The terms that apply when you use the Briefbox Digital website and hire us for AI automation, marketing, content or web development.
body:
Last updated: November 2026.

1. Our services

Briefbox Digital provides AI automation, digital marketing, content and web development services. The scope, deliverables, timeline and fees for each project are described in a written proposal, package description or invoice that you accept.

2. Payments

Fees are shown in US dollars unless stated otherwise and exclude applicable taxes. One-time projects are invoiced as agreed in the proposal. Monthly services are billed in advance. Late payments may pause work.

3. Client responsibilities

You agree to provide timely access, content, feedback and approvals, and to confirm that you have the right to use the materials you give us. Advertising budgets and third-party software fees are paid by you directly unless stated otherwise.

4. Revisions and changes

Each package includes the revisions stated in its description. Work outside the agreed scope is quoted separately.

5. Intellectual property

After full payment, you own the final deliverables created for you. We keep ownership of our pre-existing tools, templates and know-how, and may reference the project in our portfolio unless you ask us not to.

6. Results

Results from marketing, content, automation and AI tools depend on many factors outside our control. We do not guarantee specific rankings, traffic, leads or revenue.

7. Confidentiality and data

We treat non-public client information as confidential and handle personal data as described in our Privacy Policy.

8. Limitation of liability

To the extent permitted by law, our total liability is limited to the fees you paid for the service giving rise to the claim, and we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses.

9. Termination

Either party may end a monthly service with 30 days written notice. Fees for work already completed remain payable.

10. Governing law

These terms are governed by the law stated in your signed agreement or proposal. If none is stated, they are governed by the law of the country where Briefbox Digital is registered.

11. Contact

Questions about these terms? Email hello@briefboxdigital.com.

title: Cookie Policy
desc: How Briefbox Digital uses cookies and similar technologies, and how you can accept, decline or change your cookie choices at any time.
body:
Last updated: November 2026.

What cookies are

Cookies and similar technologies are small files or scripts stored in your browser. They help websites work, remember choices and understand how visitors use a site.

How we use them

  • Essential storage: remembers your cookie choice. This does not require consent.
  • Analytics: tools such as Google Analytics help us understand traffic and improve the site. These load only after you accept.
  • Advertising: tools such as Google Ads and Meta Pixel measure campaign performance and show relevant ads. These load only after you accept.

Your choices

When you first visit, you can accept or decline non-essential cookies. You can change your decision at any time with Cookie settings in the footer, or by clearing cookies in your browser. Declining does not stop you using the website.

More information

Read our Privacy Policy or email hello@briefboxdigital.com with any questions.
